source_inventory: FastF1 3.7.0 TrackStatus codes (D9 TRACK_STATE_CODES frozen); RaceControlState per replay row (track_state + flag_* + last message category/flag/age, D7 backward as-of, seq tie-break); served replay DTO already exposes all; driver DTO stops-counts only, no in-pit-now; no DNF semantics exist
status_mapping: all_clear->GREEN, yellow->YELLOW, safety_car->SAFETY CAR, vsc/vsc_ending->VIRTUAL SC, red_flag->RED FLAG, null/unknown->STATUS UNKNOWN; numeric codes never reach UI
architecture: replay frame -> raceControl prop -> raceStatus.ts view-model -> RaceStatusStrip; zero backend, zero new requests, zero new clocks
clock_contract: status shares replay T by construction (frozen row state_time_s == T); no lookup, no recomputation
causality_contract: latest event timestamp <= T only (D7 as-of); never nearest; no future look-ahead; stateful tokens carry, one-shot messages do not persist
same_time_order: D7 highest message_seq wins; track_state single-valued per lap boundary; no incidental ordering
sector_status_decision: deferred: no authoritative sector geometry; no fake polygons/thirds
pit_contract: deferred: no in-pit-now in frozen replay DTO; pit_last_* unplumbed (regen forbidden); counts already in tower; no coordinate inference
retirement_contract: rejected: no DNF semantics; UNAVAILABLE != RETIRED; NO FIX vs tower rows stay separated
race_control_decision: one bounded verbatim line for Flag/SafetyCar category + YELLOW/DOUBLE YELLOW/RED flag; BLUE/CLEAR/GREEN/CHEQUERED/BLACK AND WHITE/nulls/Drs/CarEvent/Other hidden
session_status_decision: rejected: red/all_clear transitions already convey interruption/restart; internal terminology unexposed
api_decision: no backend change (proven unnecessary); no new endpoint; no DTO widening
payload_measurements: incremental +0 requests, +0 bytes (rides replay frame fetch; network-log verified)
cache_contract: none needed (no status fetch); P12-7 geometry/frame caches untouched
integration_admission: P12-7 abort/ticket/race/frame/geometry admission untouched; strip reads replay props so late spatial responses cannot alter it
failure_degradation: nulls -> STATUS UNKNOWN; spatial failure never hides status; r09 shows GREEN strip + unavailable panel
partial_semantics: PARTIAL positions and status independent; r15 f0 YELLOW + 2 markers + 18 NO FIX
boundary_validation: frames before each event show previous state; first frame T>=E shows new state; zero early transitions
visual_validation: YELLOW + RC YELLOW strip above TRACK MAP at BHR f755 (temp screenshot); compact, neutral geometry, secondary status; ContextBar agrees
